From today, Runna subscribers can use the brand-new "Heat Adaptation" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on the temperature and humidity of their location. Details are as follows.

Runna adds training tools to cope with hot weather

The personalised running coaching app Runna today announced three updates designed to support users throughout their entire training cycle, covering everything from training in hot weather to post-race recovery.

The brand-new "Heat Adaptation" feature launches today, helping users find cooler running windows and recommending adjusted pace targets based on felt temperature, training duration, and specific workout sessions.

The "Heat Adaptation" feature uses colour coding to differentiate weather forecasts for each time slot, making it easy for users to spot the best running times at a glance and plan their training accordingly.

The following is Runna's introduction of this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature. As soon as users start a race plan ranging from 5K to 50K, the system automatically generates a corresponding recovery plan. Steph Kessell, Runna's Head Coach and former Olympian, said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of overtraining or injury."

Lastly, the platform announced that a new feature called "Upcoming Plans" will launch in August. Users can pre-schedule multiple training plans, and the system will transition seamlessly between them, further streamlining long-term training workflows.

The following outlines the benefits of Runna's "Upcoming Plans" feature:

Plan your entire year's training in minutes: Runners can stack races, mid-term goals, and training phases to get a clear overview of their yearly training at a glance. Zero admin between plans: No need to rebuild or start from scratch—when one plan ends and the next begins, your preferred training schedule, projected finish time, and current fitness level all carry over automatically. Flexible and in your control: Every plan can be edited, swapped, or deleted at any time, giving runners complete control over their training experience. Built for progress: Every plan is carefully crafted by Runna's coaching team using proven training principles to support sustainable progress, recovery, and race-day performance.
